headline: MIL @ OAK matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is MIL 5.33 at OAK 3.60, with a projected total of 8.93. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward OAK: MIL moved -0.07 runs while OAK moved +0.65, changing the projected margin by -0.73 runs. The projected total climbed +0.58, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -11.9%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Jack Perkins has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Jackson Chourio, Tyler Soderstrom, Christian Yelich, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Blake Perkins, Lawrence Butler because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
